arms.B: Exact fixture address -> current pages -> native _attempt; absent/invalid mount falls back to A
arms.C: B with structural PAGE_FAULT abstention before generation on absent/invalid mount
arms.N: Conditional C with frozen unique token-span dictionary resolver; no per-query oracle lookup

author.model: GPT-6 (system identity; exact deployment ID unavailable)

budget.resume: one next eligible cell per foreground invocation; never an unbounded loop
budget.timeout: Worker self SIGALRM raises TimeoutError; no external signals or kill. Non-returning native calls cannot be hard-preempted without violating never-kill; residual explicitly RED.

fixture_contract.absence: Same query, remove ALL target-current-version pages from eligible mounted set. Keep oracle version pointer and stale/decoy pages. Also CPU-test unknown address and partial page sets.
fixture_contract.census_decoy_limit: Census controls reuse existing Falcon competitor verbatim; it does not name every census target. Report source-stratified results.
fixture_contract.decoys: Exactly m additional children per target's existing competitor family; cycle native width-split children in source order. Original children remain. Shared immutable K/V backing, distinct IDs and metadata; no new harvest for duplicates.
fixture_contract.held_out: New query wording, frozen before tests; existing values/documents are NOT held-out entities or unseen facts. No fitting on these queries.
fixture_contract.pairing: seed 20260908; balanced rotation A/B/C by query index and condition; reset repository/cache and RNG before every arm from shared native payload snapshot; no query answer deposits

frame.demand_note: Production D-NGH default OFF, threshold config frozen unchanged. Count structural X1 demands separately; no attention telemetry.

lead_predictions.P2: B present max exact-min exact across 1,10,100 <= 0.05
lead_predictions.P3: C all-condition false(100) <= 0.5*A all-condition false(100); requires A false > 0
lead_predictions.P4: B/A and C/A mean wall-per-turn ratios at each multiplicity in [0.90,1.10]

prior_art.Codd 1970: logical relational identity; https://doi.org/10.1145/362384.362685; bibliography checked via ACM SIGMOD
prior_art.Denning 1968: bounded working sets/page absence; https://denninginstitute.com/pjd/PUBS/WSModel_1968.pdf (primary source checked)
prior_art.Fisher 1935: blocked paired experiment; unverified — lead to check: The Design of Experiments
prior_art.Reed 1978: multiversion indirection; unverified — lead to check: Naming and Synchronization in a Decentralized Computer System
prior_art.Unicode UAX15: NFKC normalization; unverified — lead to check: Unicode normalization annex 15
prior_art.house 2026: reuse EB1/SUP/RT1/RS3/RS4 and census; new work is additive address contract and this registered comparison, no novelty claim

rails.blind_verification: Lead dispatch required; author does not select or launch verifier
cpu: existing RT1 and RS3 frame tests
rails.failures: Any worker failure/incomplete receipt stops resume; no automatic retry or new fingerprint campaign. Amendment/lead decision required.
rails.kill: With exact addresses: selection depends on decoy ranking (coverage changes/missing under present) OR B present spread>0.05. Natural: N loses >0.05 exact or advantage over A100 <0.20. Strict empirical rail; thin paired sample is not a universal refutation.
rails.natural_unlock: Only oracle_positive; no override. If oracle null/negative, natural is NOT RUN.
rails.oracle_positive: All 6 cells complete, B present min exact >=0.80, spread<=0.05, B100-A100>=0.20, C absent false=0, C present>=B present-0.05 at every m, B/C present mount address coverage=1

scoring.abstention: Structural X1 fault, production abstain info, or registered full-string refusal vocabulary; no substring refusal escape
scoring.abstention_correctness: correct abstentions/all abstentions; null when none. Also report absent recall and present false abstention rate
scoring.demand: structural address misses counted separately from D-NGH demand_fired (OFF); no fabricated telemetry
scoring.exact: Full answer strip, casefold, normalized Unicode dash/whitespace, remove outer quotes and terminal . only; equality to expected value. Present denominator only.
scoring.false_answer: Any non-abstaining non-exact present answer, or any non-abstaining absent answer. Conservative: verbose correct answers still fail strict exact; record value-match diagnostic separately.
scoring.wall: GPU synchronize outside/inside timed turn boundaries; exclude reset, install, load, scoring. Raw per-turn rows plus per-condition and all-condition means

seat_predictions.S1: A present decline < 0.20: existing RT1 may already resist duplicate children
seat_predictions.S2: B present exact spread <= 0.05, but correctly mounted read errors may persist
seat_predictions.S3: C absent false rate = 0 and structural abstention correctness = 1; no generation on fault
seat_predictions.S4: B/C mean wall no more than 1.10*A; C may be faster than the P4 lower bound
seat_predictions.S5: N present exact >= C present exact-0.05, limited to the frozen dictionary aliases
